implementation.roster: Vendor type1 with frozen ordinary Shanghai/Shenzhen A-share prefixes; IPO and exit dates applied per day; official lifecycle dates retained separately
implementation.formula: 21 adjacent sessions; adjusted close 20-session return; mean 20 daily amounts; top ceil(5 percent) by amount then code; equal mean momentum; min 100 qualified stocks
implementation.memory: Process one stock's source rows at a time and fold into per-day count, sums and bounded top heap; old union date arrays are discarded after source-ref extraction
implementation.output: New external-volume directory with daily.json and audit.json; no effect labels or financial statistics
implementation.invocation: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -B -m lei_signal.research.focus_dynamic --run --output /Volumes/win+mac通用/LeiSignal-新实验结果/<new-directory>
implementation.default: Without --run, print read-only plan and write nothing

qualification_limits: Full-source run and root review remain outstanding; the synthetic tests do not qualify the real output.
Vendor roster is a retrospective candidate list, not complete point-in-time ordinary-equity membership.
Old-union codes use their SHA-bound old factor vintage through 2025-12-31; alternate v8 factor vintages are counted but not merged. Same-date conflicting factor events quarantine a code.
Official lifecycle addenda provide delisting dates, not exit prices or decision-time public availability.
Raw source dates and factor events have no certified decision-time arrival or revision timestamp; all output is retrospective observation only.
Main 31 missing source days and absent exit prices remain unresolved; missing, suspended, ST and invalid adjustment windows are excluded and audited.
